### Observed differences

- In the later window, activity A01 appears in all 200 traces (previously in none), while A05 appears in none (previously in all 200). [OCC001, OCC002]
- A01 now always leads to A03; previously A05 always led to A03. [DIR001, DIR003]
- The outgoing edges of A02, A06 and A07 shifted from A05 to A01: A02 went to A05 in about 72% of its transitions before and to A01 in 75% after; A06 went to A05 in about 29% before and to A01 in about 30% after; A07 went to A05 in about 71% before and to A01 in 66% after. [DIR002, DIR004, DIR005]
- A01 occupies the same middle position (position 0.5) that A05 occupied before. [POS001, POS002]
- A01 now co-occurs with A02, A06 and A07 in about half the traces, with those activities preceding A01; before, A05 co-occurred with them in similar proportions and was preceded by them. [REL001, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL008, REL009]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that activity A05 was replaced by A01 in the process. In the later window, A01 takes over the role previously held by A05: it appears in every trace, is preceded by A02, A06 and A07, and leads to A03, while A05 disappears entirely. The change is consistent across occurrence, direction, position and relation indicators, and the number of qualifying items (18) far exceeds the 0.13 expected by chance. A competing explanation that A01 is simply a renamed A05 cannot be ruled out, but the behavioural difference is clear.

Other differences: None beyond the replacement; the alternative paths among A02, A06 and A07 remain largely unchanged.

We have 200 traces before and after. Screening: 26 units tested, expected 0.13 items by chance, but 18 items observed (all control flow). So many more than expected. So we can consider a hypothesis.

Evidence items: OCC001: A01 appears in 0% before, 100% after (mean 1.0 per trace). OCC002: A05 appears in 100% before, 0% after. So A01 replaced A05? But also other changes.

DIR001: A01's outgoing transitions: before none (since A01 absent), after all to A03. DIR002: A02's outgoing: before to A05 (72%) and A06 (28%); after to A01 (75%) and A06 (25%). So A02 now goes to A01 instead of A05. DIR003: A05's outgoing: before all to A03; after none (A05 absent). DIR004: A06's outgoing: before to A02 (34%), A07 (37.5%), A05 (28.5%); after to A07 (33%), A02 (37.5%), A01 (29.5%). So A06 now goes to A01 instead of A05. DIR005: A07's outgoing: before to A05 (71%) and A06 (29%); after to A01 (66%) and A06 (34%). So A07 now goes to A01 instead of A05.

POS001: A01 position: before absent, after at position 0.5 (middle). POS002: A05 position: before at 0.5, after absent.

REL items: REL001 (A01,A02): before: A02 only 47%, neither 53%, no cooccurrence; after: cooccurrence 50%, A01 only 50%, B_before_A 50% (i.e., A02 before A01? Actually B_before_A means B (A02) before A (A01) in 50% of traces? Wait components: A_before_B, B_before_A. In after, cooccurrence 0.5, A_only 0.5, B_before_A 0.5. So in half the traces both occur with A02 before A01, in half only A01. So A01 and A02 now co-occur in half, with A02 before A01. Before they never co-occurred; A02 alone in 47%, neither in 53%.

REL002 (A01,A03): before: B_only (A03) 100% (since A01 absent, A03 always present? Actually B_only=1.0 means A03 present, A01 absent). After: cooccurrence 1.0, A_before_B 1.0 (A01 before A03). So A01 now always precedes A03.

REL003 (A01,A05): before: B_only (A05) 100%; after: A_only (A01) 100%. So A05 replaced by A01.

REL004 (A01,A06): before: B_only (A06) 100%; after: cooccurrence 1.0, B_before_A 1.0 (A06 before A01). So A06 now always before A01.

REL005 (A01,A07): before: B_only (A07) 53%, neither 47%; after: cooccurrence 50%, A_only 50%, B_before_A 50% (A07 before A01). So similar to REL001.

REL006 (A02,A05): before: cooccurrence 47%, A_before_B 47% (A02 before A05), B_only 53% (A05 alone). After: A_only (A02) 50%, neither 50%. So A02 and A05 no longer co-occur; A05 gone.

REL007 (A03,A05): before: cooccurrence 1.0, B_before_A 1.0 (A05 before A03). After: A_only (A03) 100%. So A05 gone, A03 alone.

REL008 (A05,A06): before: cooccurrence 1.0, B_before_A 1.0 (A06 before A05). After: B_only (A06) 100%. So A05 gone, A06 alone.

REL009 (A05,A07): before: cooccurrence 53%, A_only (A05) 47%, B_before_A 53% (A07 before A05). After: B_only (A07) 50%, neither 50%. So A05 gone.

So overall: A05 disappears entirely in the later window. A01 appears in every trace. A01 seems to take the place of A05 in the process. Also A02, A06, A07 now connect to A01 instead of A05. A03 now follows A01 (A01 before A03). A06 and A07 now precede A01 (B_before_A). A02 also precedes A01 in half the traces? Actually REL001 shows A02 before A01 in 50% of traces (cooccurrence 0.5 with B_before_A 0.5). So the process seems to have changed from a path involving A05 to a path involving A01, with A01 inserted somewhere in the middle.

Let's reconstruct the before process: A05 was present in all traces. A05's outgoing was to A03 (DIR003). A02 went to A05 (72%) and A06 (28%). A06 went to A02, A07, A05. A07 went to A05 and A06. Wait REL007 values A03,A05: A_before_B means A03 before A05, B_before_A means A05 before A03. Before: B_before_A=1.0, so A05 before A03. So A05 -> A03. REL008: A05,A06: B_before_A=1.0 means A06 before A05. So A06 -> A05. REL009: A05,A07: B_before_A=0.53 means A07 before A05. So A07 -> A05. So before: A02 -> A05 (or A06), A06 -> A05 (or A02/A07), A07 -> A05 (or A06), A05 -> A03. So A05 is a central activity before A03.

After: A01 appears. A02 -> A01 (75%) or A06 (25%). A06 -> A01 (29.5%) or A02/A07. A07 -> A01 (66%) or A06 (34%). A01 -> A03 (DIR001). Also A06 -> A01, A07 -> A01, A02 -> A01. And A01 is preceded by A06, A07, A02 (in some traces). So A01 replaces A05 as the activity that leads to A03. Also A05 is gone.
